verdict.rationale: Puzzle is presented throughout as a vendor-hosted SaaS accounting product (app.puzzle.io, api.puzzle.io). Self-hosting is a fair question for accounting software, but nothing in the evidence describes a self-hosted, on-prem, or open-source deployment option. The documented sandbox is a vendor-run staging server with credentials issued on request, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
